name: Securities Settlement Status 2 Code
definition: Provides the status of settlement of an instruction.

PEND.name: Pending
PEND.definition: Instruction is pending. Settlement at the instructed settlement date is still possible.

PENF.name: Failing
PENF.definition: Instruction is failing. Settlement at the instructed settlement date is no longer possible.

PAIN.name: Partial Settlement
PAIN.definition: Part of the instruction remains unsettled.
